en: A monochrome postcard styled as the front page of the Italian newspaper 'IL BRENNERO – Quotidiano Fascista Tridentino'. The layout includes the masthead at the top, a large quotation in Italian attributed to Mussolini on the right, and two photographs on the left and bottom. The upper photo shows Mussolini speaking from a decorated podium under arches to a crowd. The lower panoramic photo depicts a vast crowd filling a city square, surrounded by multi‑story buildings; one roof shows the sign 'LANO'. The imagery and text celebrate Mussolini's visit to the city of Trento.
